name: peek-folder
title: Peek Folder
description: Tiles tucked in a frosted-glass folder pocket, glowing through it; tap or hover and they spring up and fan out.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas: the tiles move by transforms from one UI-thread spring and the glass is a single backdrop blur. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The tiles jump between tucked and lifted without the spring or the drop-in.
a11y.screenReader: The folder is a button named by `label` with its expanded state; the arrow is a separate "Open …" button.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole folder is the toggle; the arrow button is 44 pt.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { PeekFolder } from '@/components/kinetik/peek-folder';

<PeekFolder
  label="Design assets"
  items={[
    { glyph: typeIconPath, color: '#FF6A00' },
    { glyph: shapesIconPath, color: '#111' },
    { glyph: sparkIconPath, color: '#0A84FF' },
  ]}
  onOpen={() => router.push('/assets')}
/>;
```

## When to use

- A playful entry point to a collection: a folder, an album, a kit.

## When not to use

- File browsers with many folders: the blur and the motion are for a few hero items.

## Notes

- `glyph` is an SVG path on a 24 pt grid, drawn as a bold stroke. Join an icon's paths with spaces.
- Uncontrolled by default; pass `open` and `onOpenChange` to drive it yourself.
- `hover` lifts the tiles while a pointer is over the folder on the web.
- The glass is a Skia backdrop blur clipped to the pocket, so the tiles' colours glow through it.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add peek-folder`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
